title: Fix update notice test failure on GitHub CI

acceptanceCriteria.text: Installed CLI detects cached notices regardless of Windows path casing.

notes: Hosted CI uses a Windows 8.3 short path while Bun resolves the CLI to its long path. Bun realpathSync retains short names; realpathSync.native expands them. A real GetShortPathNameW regression failed before the fix and passes after. Full bun test: 193 pass, 0 fail. Hosted CI pending.
